The academic report contains runtime or retrieval-process prose instead of scientific analysis: line 61 reads 按 RoB 2，上述随机双盲安慰剂对照试验在随机化与盲法条目偏倚风险低 [2]；未检索到可用 ROBINS-I 评定的非随机干预性研究；未检索到可获取全文的指南以完成 AGREE II 评定；…. Write what the evidence shows, not how it was obtained — the run's tools, gateways, preserved artifacts (工件), access levels (访问层级), environment (本环境), and retrieval passes (本轮检索) belong in the run receipt. A source you could not obtain is stated as a limitation of the evidence base inside 局限性, in the reader's terms.
